title: Satay Sauce
description: Rich, creamy, slightly spicy, and perfect for chicken, beef, lamb, veggies — or eaten straight from the pan when no one’s watching.

ingredients.item: Water — add a splash at a time to thin

method.instruction: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.
Warm gently over low heat — no high flames.
Stir patiently until smooth and combined.
Add tiny splashes of water if too thick. Do not make soup.

notes.title: Cooking Tip
notes.content: Add Keen’s curry powder gradually and taste-test like a curious cat; you can always add more later, but too much will make your tongue stage a protest!
